paper.printed_page_2_text: The total sampling capacitor is 28pF to meet kT/C noise requirement.
paper.P_N_half_split: not disclosed; Fig. 2 shows one simplified DAC1 bank without an explicit P/N split
paper.conditional_reading: If 28pF is per side, the model per-side group Ceq is close. If 28pF is the combined P+N total, the model two-side sum is about 1.97x that figure.

model_capacitance.nominal_cap_definition: ASSUMED per-side bank capacitance; must resolve SPEC open input
model_capacitance.actual_C_source: PoolAnalogCfg.C_signal_f[s] = sum(PoolAnalogCfg.C_branch_f[s,1:33,half]); saved P/N signal branches match exactly
model_capacitance.differential_equivalent_cap_note: Ceq_side/2 is only the kT/C mathematical equivalent for differential variance, not the physical P+N capacitor sum.

formula.finite_aperture_code_formula: For each slice/side: Cmode=diag(Cbranch_signal[1:33], Cp+sum(Ctail)); A=Cmode^-1*Gmode; F=exp(-A*Ta); Sigma(Ta)=kBT*Cmode^-1 - F*(kBT*Cmode^-1)*F^T. Then branch-weighted slice variances are summed with saved C_signal weights across slices and P/N.
formula.units: C in F, T in K, kBT/C in V^2, sigma in V_rms; SNR=10log10(Vsignal_rms^2/sigma_diff^2).
formula.budget_scope: The numeric RMS/SNR values below use full-aperture equilibrium kT/C as a reference. The actual owner injects finite-aperture RC covariance and does not expose a realized N8 noise estimate.

activation.legacy_route_note: The chi=2 scalar formula belongs to the disabled generic front-noise path; it is not an extra factor on the active physical sample-kTC covariance.
activation.thermal_modes: signal bottoms 1:33 plus sample/strap/top-sample resistors; tail/reference bottoms 34:38 are noiseless fixed targets but load the top
activation.excluded: RA/AZ/DAC branch noise and finite source/reference noise modes

SNR_budget.input_convention: Differential sine peak amplitude divided by sqrt(2) for RMS; compare differential RMS to differential kT/C RMS.
SNR_budget.not_a_measurement: These are conditional one-source analytical references, not measured SNR/SNDR, not an N8 estimate, and not a reproduction of the paper performance.
